DPoP (RFC 9449) for ASP.NET Core JWT bearer authentication: accepts Authorization: DPoP, validates the proof of DPoP-bound access tokens against cnf.jkt, rejects them as bearer tokens, issues DPoP nonces and answers with DPoP challenges. Works with any OAuth 2.0 server.

Access tokens for HttpClient without ASP.NET Core: client credentials tokens sent as bearer tokens or DPoP-bound (RFC 9449), with caching, renewal and DPoP nonces, plus the token endpoint client and the handler base that MinApiLib.Oidc.Authentication builds on. Works with any OAuth 2.0 server.

The signed-in user's access tokens for HttpClient in ASP.NET Core: keeps the tokens of an OpenID Connect scheme in the session, refreshes them and sends them as bearer tokens or DPoP-bound (RFC 9449), with the authorization code bound to the key (dpop_jkt). Works with any OpenID Connect server.
DPoP (RFC 9449) building blocks shared by clients, resource servers and MinApiLib.Oidc.Server: keys, proofs, RFC 7638 thumbprints, nonces and the protocol's names.

OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 server for ASP.NET Core built on MinApiLib endpoints and attribute-based dependency injection. Includes code derived from IdentityServer4 4.1.2 (Apache-2.0); it does not depend on any IdentityServer package.
MongoDB stores for MinApiLib.Oidc.Server: clients, resources, CORS origins, persisted grants, device codes and signing keys, with TTL indexes that expire grants and device codes.
